paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the printed locator קכה. (125). But Hyman says the reading should be “R' Chilfai said”: the word Yehoshua intruded from the following line, as noted in the glosses signed רש״ב there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פסדר״כ is contextually Pesikta de-Rav Kahana; machine בפדר״כ differs from supplied בפסדר״כ. קכה. is 125 with punctuation, without proof of page/folio or a-side; no 125a is asserted. רש״ב remains literal initials rather than a partial/full personal identification such as Buber.

צ״ל preserves Hyman’s directed correction from heading Yehoshua Chilfai to the reporting formula. Following-line intrusion and gloss support are his claims, not new printed correction-history proof. Both personal-title abbreviations remain R'; work-name Rav Kahana supplies no title to either person.
